detail.title: Analysis of Counterfactual Scoring and Foundational Reasoning Limits
detail.summary: We analyze how multi-turn reasoning models exhibit distinct failure modes and behavioral shifts under external oversight, integrating recent findings on automated incident reasoning and oversight sensitivity.
detail.reason: Revise notebook claims with newly retrieved failure mode and agentic reasoning evidence.
